description: This file implements the Order API controller for OpenCart, providing endpoint functionalities such as setting customer info, cart management, shipping and payment methods, order confirmation, and history updates.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: API Controller class for managing order-related operations such as creating, updating, and adding history to orders within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point of the API, routing calls based on the 'call' parameter.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Loads customer data using the API controller.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Loads the payment address via the API controller.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address, loading cart and shipping address controllers.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods after ensuring customer and cart info are valid.

methods.name: setShippingMethod
methods.description: Sets shipping method after validating cart and addresses.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves valid payment methods based on current cart and address state.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets payment method with dependencies and extensions loaded.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles extension-specific API calls, loading extension data and controllers.

methods.name: setAffiliate
methods.description: Associates an affiliate with the current order context.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves current cart content, including products, totals, and shipping requirements.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and updates totals and shipping info.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Finalizes the order, validating cart, payment, shipping, and customer data, then creates or updates the order record.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds order history updates like status changes and comments.
